description: Create all Expo Router screens: root layout, tab layout with 4 tabs (Home, Movies, TV, Search), detail pages (movie/[id], tv/[id]), player screen, and home screen with Continue Watching section.
steps: Create /apps/mobile/src/app/_layout.jsx - root layout that wraps the app with QueryClientProvider (@tanstack/react-query), SafeAreaProvider, and loads Inter font via expo-font. Sets up dark StatusBar. Uses Stack from expo-router with headerShown: false.
Create /apps/mobile/src/app/index.jsx - entry redirect to (tabs)/home using expo-router Redirect component.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.jsx - tab layout using expo-router Tabs component. 4 tabs: Home (Home icon), Movies (Film icon), TV (Tv icon), Search (Search icon). Tab bar styled dark with active color #2563EB. Icons from lucide-react-native.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/home.jsx - home screen. Shows 'Continue Watching' section (horizontal FlatList of items from getAllWatchProgress). Below shows 'Trending Movies' row and 'Trending TV' row - each a horizontal FlatList with ContentCards. Uses @tanstack/react-query to fetch trending data from api.js.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/movies.jsx - movies browse screen. TabBar at top (Latest, Trending, Top Rated, Upcoming). ContentGrid below showing paginated movie results. Uses useInfiniteQuery for pagination with onEndReached loading more pages.
Create /apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/tv.jsx - TV shows browse screen. Same pattern as movies.jsx but for TV endpoints (getLatestTV, getTrendingTV, getTopRatedTV). TabBar + ContentGrid with pagination.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/search.jsx - search screen with SearchBar at top and ContentGrid below showing results. Uses useQuery with enabled: query.length > 0. Shows empty state when no query.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/movie/[id].jsx - movie detail screen. Uses useLocalSearchParams() to get id. Fetches movie details with useQuery + api.getMovieDetails(id). Shows DetailHero component. Play button navigates to player screen.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/tv/[id].jsx - TV detail screen. Fetches TV details with useQuery + api.getTVDetails(id). Shows DetailHero + EpisodeList. Play episode navigates to player with season/episode params.

Create /apps/mobile/src/app/player.jsx - player screen. Receives params (type, id, season, episode) via useLocalSearchParams(). Constructs embed URL using player.js utilities. Renders VideoPlayer component full screen. Back button returns to previous screen.
acceptance_criteria: All screen files exist in the correct Expo Router file structure under /apps/mobile/src/app/
Root layout provides QueryClientProvider and font loading
Tab layout has 4 tabs with correct icons
Home screen shows Continue Watching and trending content
Movies and TV screens have tab navigation and paginated grids
Detail screens fetch and display content correctly
Player screen constructs correct embed URL and renders WebView player
All screens use dark theme styling consistent with TV viewing
The app can be exported with `bunx expo export --platform android` without build errors
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bunx expo export --platform android` to verify the app compiles
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bun run lint` if lint is configured
